prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: Create a surreal, cinematic scene set in a seamless, glowing green studio environment. In the center, place a futuristic, high-end SUV with illuminated accents and sleek, modern lines, its headlights casting a soft glow. Three human figures are present: one stands barefoot in the middle ground, facing the car with their back to the viewer, wearing a form-fitting, neon yellow outfit and long, braided hair cascading down their back. On either side of the scene, two other figures lie sprawled on the ground in dramatic, almost theatrical poses—one on the left in a brown puffer jacket and patterned pants, the other on the right in a teal jacket and dark pants, both with limbs extended and faces partially obscured. The lighting is even and diffused, creating a dreamlike, otherworldly atmosphere with no visible shadows. The color palette is dominated by vibrant greens and yellows, enhancing the surreal, hyperreal quality. The composition is wide and balanced, with a shallow depth of field that keeps all elements in sharp focus, evoking a sense of suspended motion and enigmatic narrative tension.
